summary: Both refactor (Riforma 2027) and bugfix (removed react-native-keyboard-controller) verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed — /api/content returns 200 with 'riforma' block WITHOUT 'fasi' and intro containing 'in tutta Italia dal 2027'; /api/assistant returns valid text via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Frontend: app loads on Expo web (no white screen / crash), all 7 acceptance flows pass — home banner 'Come funziona · Riforma 2027' + tagline 'Riforma della disabilità 2027' present, /riforma header 'Come funziona' with cosa-cambia + salvaguardia and NO provincia input, wizard 3 steps completable with inline cert warning and no provincia/riforma-note, /risultati/{id} shows next-steps cards (cert-explainer, law104, invalidity) and NO deadline card / iter-2027-banner, /tracker shows bell + Sarzana, /faq and /importi load with content. Only non-blocking React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*) observed in console.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web logs deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use 'boxShadow' / 'textShadow'). Non-blocking on web. Sources include index.tsx trackerCard (shadow*) and heroImageText (textShadow*). Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:906-911 and :788-790

action_items: (Cosmetic) Migrate 'shadow*'/'textShadow*' style props to 'boxShadow'/'textShadow' for React Native Web compatibility to silence deprecation warnings.

(Cleanup, non-blocking) Remove unused StyleSheet keys left over from provincia/riforma-transition (riformaNote*, provCard/provInput/provEsito* in valutazione.tsx; card/searchRow/esitoBox in riforma.tsx) — not causing runtime issues but noted in the review context.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py mounts routers and CORS middleware AFTER app.include_router — CORS still applied because add_middleware wraps the app but order-wise it is fine for FastAPI; no functional impact observed.

app_content.py APP_CONTENT_SEED is idempotently inserted but existing docs are never migrated by code — the request note mentions Mongo doc was already migrated manually, verified via GET /api/content.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; test uses live Mongo app_content already migrated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_riforma_2027.py verifies GET /api/content (no 'fasi', intro '...in tutta Italia dal 2027') and POST /api/assistant. Frontend flow test in this iteration walks home → /riforma → wizard 3 steps → /risultati/{id} → /tracker → /faq → /importi asserting presence/absence of key testIDs (riforma-provincia-input, wizard-prov-input, wizard-riforma-note, results-deadline, iter-2027-banner must be absent).
rca_of_issue: N/A — both interventions verified. Bugfix (removed react-native-keyboard-controller) confirmed: Expo web renders the app without red-screen and KeyboardAvoidingView native is used in valutazione.tsx.
